jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Fellow in Quantum Algorithms and Quantum Software
jobs.description:
The position
The Centre for Quantum Mathematics (QM) at the Department of Mathematics and Computer Science, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), seeks outstanding candidates to fill a number of 2-3-year postdotoral positions in quantum algorithms and quantum software.
The targeted starting date of the position is 01.08.2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

About the Centre for Quantum Mathematics (QM)
Over the past seven years, QM has built a highly international and interdisciplinary research environment spanning a broad spectrum of pure mathematics, mathematical physics and quantum computer science. The Centre has attracted leading international researchers to Odense and developed a unique research environment spanning both fundamental and applied research.
The University of Southern Denmark has recently invested DKK 50 million in the Centre for Quantum Mathematics, on top of its continuous substantial basic funding of the centre, which will enable the Centre to further expand its scientific capacity, attract and retain leading international researchers, increase the acquisition of competitive external research funding and establish strategic collaborations with industry, public authorities and international partners.
As part of this continued development and expansion, QM will move into a new dedicated building from next year. The new building will be located on the SDU campus in Odense and will provide a dedicated research environment for the Centre and its growing international research community.

Research activities and funding
The QM centre is located at the Faculty of Science on the international campus in Odense, Denmark and it is hosting several large European, Danish and American grants including “New Structures in Low-Dimensional Topology” (Simons Collaboration) & “Topological Photonic Quantum Computing and its Applications” (Innovation Fund Denmark) both led by PI and Centre Director Jørgen Ellegaard Andersen; “Mathematics of the open topological string” (VILLUM Investigator) led by Professor Vivek Shende; “The Quantum Geometry of Dynamical Systems” (VILLUM Ascending Investigator) and “The Emergent Geometry of Categories” (DFF Sapere Aude) both led by Associate Professor Fabian Haiden; “New invariants in low-dimensional topology via quantum field theory” (VILLUM Young Investigator) led by Associate Professor Du Pei, “Global Categorical Symmetries and Phases of Quantum Matter” (VILLUM Young Investigator) led by Assistant Professor Apoorv Tiwari, “From Pertubative to Non-pertubative Quantum Field Theory by cutting and gluing” (DFF Sapere Aude) led by Assistant Professor Konstantin Wernli and finally “Leveraging Algebraic Geometry for High-Precision Fundamental Physics“ (DFF Sapere Aude) led by Associate Professor Matthias Wilhelm.

Job description
A successful candidate will help drive internationally competitive research, collaborate with the world community in the field, and contribute to QM’s excellent research environment. The candidates will get the opportunity to shape the development together with the team and implement research project ideas with national and international impact. 
Topics of interest: mathematics, mathematical physics, quantum algorithms, quantum software architecture and quantum computing.

We expect
The candidates must have a PhD degree in pure or applied mathematics, computer science or theoretical physics and a strong research record. 
The candidates must further have an emerging research track in the field. We are seeking highly motivated candidates, who work and communicate well in an international team. The candidates must be able to carry out independent and rigorous work at top international level.
Fluency in English is required. Knowledge of Danish is not a prerequisite for application. The hired candidate will be offered Danish courses by the university.

Living and working in Odense
Odense is a fast-growing international community with an open Scandinavian culture, affordable housing and living costs.

Application deadline: 3. January 2027 at 23:59 hours local Danish time
Please see the full call, including how to apply, on www.sdu.dk

jobs.occupation: PhD Position in Organic and Supramolecular Chemistry: Electrically Controlled Cargo Release in [2]Rotaxanes via Mechanochemical Retro Diels-Alder Reactions at SDU in Odense
jobs.description:
A 3-year (5+3) or 4-year (4+4) PhD position in organic and supramolecular chemistry is available for a highly motivated candidate at the Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy (FKF) at the University of Southern Denmark. The position is funded by a DFF-Research Project 1 grant from the Independent Research Fund Denmark – Natural Sciences and is available from January 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.
The project focuses on the design and synthesis of electroactive molecular machines capable of converting electrically controlled molecular motion into mechanical force. In particular, the project will investigate whether redox-induced shuttling in mechanically interlocked molecules can be used to trigger the cleavage of covalent bonds and thereby enable controlled cargo release.

Project Background
The aim of this project is to develop electrically responsive molecular machines capable of converting redox-induced molecular motion into covalent cargo release.
Specifically, the project will focus on the design and synthesis of [2]rotaxanes incorporating a redox-active monopyrrolotetrathiafulvalene (MPTTF) unit, a cyclobis(paraquat-p-phenylene) (CBPQT4+) macrocycle, and a furan-based unit linked to a cargo molecule through a Diels–Alder adduct.
Upon electrochemical oxidation of the MPTTF unit, the CBPQT4+ macrocycle is expected to undergo shuttling along the molecular axle. The central hypothesis is that this redox-induced motion can generate sufficient mechanical force to promote a retro-Diels–Alder reaction, resulting in the release of the covalently attached cargo molecule. A key objective is to establish a direct mechanistic relationship between redox-induced macrocycle movement, the generation of mechanical force, and the cleavage of a covalent bond.
The project will involve extensive synthetic organic chemistry, the preparation and characterization of mechanically interlocked molecules, and investigations of their electrochemical and mechanical properties using techniques such as NMR spectroscopy, mass spectrometry, UV–vis spectroscopy, and cyclic voltammetry.

By combining synthetic, spectroscopic, and electrochemical studies, the project aims to establish whether electrically driven molecular motion can be harnessed to induce covalent bond cleavage. The results are expected to contribute to the fundamental understanding of force transduction in artificial molecular machines and may provide a foundation for future applications in controlled molecular release.

Qualifications
The ideal candidate holds a Master's degree (5+3 programme) or a Bachelor's degree (4+4 programme) in chemistry or a closely related field, preferably with a strong background in synthetic organic chemistry.

The successful candidate should have:

• 
Extensive practical experience in synthetic organic chemistry.

• 
A strong interest in supramolecular chemistry and molecular machines.

• 
Experience with standard analytical and spectroscopic characterization techniques.

• 
The ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a research environment.

• 
Good communication skills and proficiency in written and spoken English.

Previous experience in supramolecular chemistry, mechanically interlocked molecules, or tetrathiafulvalene chemistry would be an advantage but is not a prerequisite.
The successful candidate will also be expected to contribute to the supervision of Bachelor's and Master's students working on research projects within the group.

To learn more about the PhD programme at the Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy, read more here. 

Natural Science Research – Interdisciplinary Strength
The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy is one of four departments at the Faculty of Science, SDU and is located in Odense. At the Department, we contribute to solving some of society’s greatest challenges within energy, environment, health, and sustainability. We succeed because we build bridges between disciplines and transcend traditional boundaries. Our interdisciplinary mindset is not only a fundamental condition, but also our strength. And it is a strength that ensures our research and education are recognized both nationally and internationally.

Our vision is to create and apply knowledge across the natural sciences. We are unique in housing research within physics, chemistry, and pharmacy under one department, which provides excellent opportunities to explore the intersections between these disciplines. Read more about our vision here.

jobs.occupation: New model for activated sludge flocculation integrating cellular biochemical reaction potential with the microbial ecology
jobs.employer_name: Technical Sciences - Institit for Bio- og Kemitekn
jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Biological and Chemical Engineering programme. The position is based on a collaboration between Novonesis and Aarhus University and is available from 15 January 2027 or later. The PhD project is funded through the Helix Lab Renewal grant from the Novo Nordisk foundation. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title:
New model for activated sludge flocculation integrating cellular biochemical reaction potential with the microbial ecology

Research area and project description:
While bacterial and activated sludge flocculation is the most important component of wastewater treatment processes, mechanisms governing flocculation are poorly understood. It is difficult to control and optimize activated sludge flocculation, and so downstream clarifiers for removing activated sludge from treated water are overdesigned or overloaded.

Effective flocculation is currently explained in terms of achieving the right balance between good and bad flocculating bacteria. Industrial wastewater treatment plants commonly experience poor flocculating sludges with impaired flocculation, which is attributed to too many bad flocculating bacteria.

However, there is in fact a poor correlation between the microbial ecology of industrial wastewater treatment activated sludges and flocculation.
In this project the candidate will build on ongoing research in the host lab demonstrating that biochemical reactions occur within activation sludge that also likely promote flocculation The candidate will establish abiotic and biotic activated sludge models, assess the effect of flocculation stressors characteristic of industrial wastewaters, as well as biological, chemical and mechanical strategies for overcoming these. The research will inform strategies for the industrial to consider to increase the hydraulic of their wastewater treatment plant.

Qualifications and specific competences:
Applicants to the PhD position must have a relevant master's degree in biology, biotechnology, biochemistry, biological or chemical engineering or a closely related field.

Place of employment and place of work:
The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the place of work will be divided approximately evenly between Department of Biological and Chemical Engineering, Ole Worms Alle 3, 8000 Aarhus C., Denmark, and Novonesis, Hallas Alle 1, 4400 Kalundborg, Denmark or Helix Lab, Campus Kalundborg 3, 4400 Kalundborg, Denmark.

About Helix Lab
Helix Lab is a research and education center in Kalundborg, Denmark, facilitating collaborative MSc and PhD projects between Danish universities and local industry partners. As part of the PhD project, some experimental activities are expected to take place at Helix Lab, providing access to its laboratory facilities and research environment. The PhD student will also be invited to join the Helix Lab scientific community, consisting of PhD students, researchers, and specialists working on industry-related research projects in Kalundborg.

jobs.occupation: Postdoc at CBS in work-life balance policy: citizens, policies and firms
jobs.description:
Copenhagen Business School invites applications for a vacant postdoc position in work-life balance policy: citizens, policies and firms, at the Department of International Economics, Government & Business.

Expected starting date is 1 March 2027.

EGB is a multidisciplinary department that conducts high-quality research in the fields of international business and political science with direct relevance to business, policymakers, and the public. Research at the department focuses on two principal focus areas, Business & Government and International Business, in relation to societal challenges. These challenges include the consequences of inequality; the impact of technological change and digital transformation; the ethical dilemmas facing MNEs, regulating societal challenges, the changes brought about by emerging markets and the rise of Asia; the consequences of global shifts for public policy, and the relationship between business and democracy. 

Faculty apply advanced quantitative and qualitative methods to generate systematic knowledge about business-government relations and international business relations. To learn more about the research and education of the department, please visit the departmental website.

Much of EGB’s teaching is affiliated with the BSc/MSc in International Business and Politics (IBP); the BSc/MSc in International Business (IB); and the BSc in International Business in Asia (IBA).

The postdoc is to be recruited for a project funded by the Velux Foundation entitled ‘AchievinG work-LIFE balance: citizens, policies and firm perspectives (AGILE work-life balance)’, led by PI Caroline de la Porte. Read the synopsis of the project here (in Danish): VELUX FONDEN fremmer viden om vores kultur, historie og samfund: Støtter grundforskning med 40 mio. kroner | Velux and the website (in English) here: https://agile-wlb.cbs.dk/. The project focuses on values and preferences (citizen perspective), policies, and practices (firm-level) regarding work-care-life balance in four different countries and at EU level.

It would be an advantage to have a sociological background, with a focus on leisure and care intersections. The recruited postdoc is also expected to have a particular expertise in collecting interview data (citizens in different sectors & social partners) as well as survey design. It would be preferable that the candidate has some country-specific expertise on Austria, which is one of four case countries. The research will be undertaken in English, and the broader dissemination of the project results will be in Danish and English.

The postdoc is a non-tenured position for 1 year and 10 months with teaching obligation of 40%.

To fulfill the research requirements of the position, the applicant chosen is expected to be physically present on a regular basis and actively participate in the teaching and research activities of the department.

Qualifications

The applicant must hold a PhD or the equivalent in the social sciences, preferably in sociology. In assessing applications, particular emphasis will be placed on research potential.

Emphasis is placed on research relevant to the job description.

The applicant must have professional proficiency in English (written and spoken).

Copenhagen Business School has a broad commitment to the excellence, distinctiveness and relevance of its teaching and research programmes. Candidates who wish to join us should demonstrate enthusiasm for working in an organisation of this type (highlighting, for example, relevant professional, educational and dissemination activities).

For further information on the department please contact: Head of Department Jens Gammelgaard, e-mail: jg.egb@cbs.dk. For information about the AGILE project and your concrete expected tasks, please contact PI Caroline de la Porte, Tel: +4541852462, e-mail: cdlp.egb@cbs.dk

Information about the department may be found at www.cbs.dk/egb.

Appointment and salary will be in accordance with the Ministry of Finance’s agreement with the Central Academic Organisation.

Application must be sent via the electronic recruitment system, using the link below.

Application must include

• A summary of the candidate’s main strengthens and abilities.
• A complete, numbered list of publications (indicating titles, co-authors, page numbers and year) with an * marking of the academic productions to be considered during the review. A maximum of 5 publications for review are allowed. Applicants are requested to prioritise their publications in relation to the field of this job advertisement.
• Copies of the publications marked with an *. Only publications written in English (or another specified principal language, according to research tradition) or one of the Scandinavian languages will be taken into consideration)
• Information indicating experience in research management, industry co-operation and international co-operation.

Recruitment procedure

The Recruitment Committee will shortlist minimum two applicants; when possible five or more applicants will be shortlisted. The shortlisted applicants will be assessed by the Assessment Committee. All applicants will be notified of their status in the recruitment process shortly after the application deadline. 

The applicants selected for assessment will be notified about the composition of the Assessment Committee and later in the process about the result of the assessment.

Once the recruitment process is completed each applicant will be notified of the outcome of their application.

Copenhagen Business School invites all qualified candidates to apply for the position. An appointment committee will review the applications and invite a selection of qualified candidates to an interview.

One of CBS’ strategic goals is the promotion of diversity, which is why every effort has been made to ensure a recruitment process that reduces potential bias. Applicants are therefore encouraged not to include a photo or unnecessary personal information in their application.

jobs.occupation: Procurement Category Manager Logistics & Transport
jobs.description:
ValueOne is recruiting a Procurement Category Manager Logistics & Transport for Haugen-Gruppen Nordic AS. In this newly established role, you will be responsible for driving and developing the Group's strategic procurement activities within the logistics and transportation category. The position is physically based at the Danish subsidiary's office south of Copenhagen and reports to Head of Supply Chain Operations & Development. We welcome applications from candidates residing in both Sweden and Denmark.

About Haugen-Gruppen Nordic AS

Haugen-Gruppen Nordic AS is one of the Nordic region's leading distributors and brand partners within food, beverages, snacks, and confectionery. With more than 100 years of experience, the Group helps both international and proprietary brands grow across the Nordic markets through strong capabilities in marketing, sales, logistics, and category development. Supply Chain is regarded as a key competitive advantage, with a strong focus on customer and brand value while ensuring the right balance between service and cost. The company currently generates annual revenues of MNOK 4500 and employs approximately 400 people across the Nordic countries. Following an acquisition in 2026, Haugen-Gruppen has also established a presence in Poland and intends to continue expanding beyond the Nordic region.

About the Role

The Procurement Category Manager Logistics & Transport is part of the Nordic Supply Chain team and responsible for strategic sourcing and category management at Group level within transportation, third-party logistics (3PL), warehouse equipment, packaging materials and load carriers, and, where relevant, selected third-party manufacturing. The role works closely with stakeholders across the various markets to develop competitive and sustainable supplier solutions that strengthen Haugen-Gruppen's supply chain while ensuring the right service levels and total cost position.

Key Responsibilities

• Own and develop the Group-wide Logistics & Transport category strategy.

• Lead strategic sourcing and procurement initiatives across transportation, 3PL, warehousing, and related logistics services.

• Drive the Source-to-Contract process, including sourcing strategy, tendering, negotiations, contracting, and implementation.

• Develop and optimize Route-to-Market solutions in collaboration with Supply Chain and Commercial stakeholders.

• Manage supplier relationships, commercial agreements, and performance to ensure competitiveness, service excellence, and sustainability.

• Identify cost optimization opportunities through spend analysis, market intelligence, and supplier development.

• Mitigate supplier risk and ensure compliance with Group policies, standards, and sustainability requirements.

• Support strategic sourcing initiatives across adjacent supply chain categories when required.

Experience and Qualifications

To succeed in this role, you should have:

• A Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Business Administration, or a related field, alternatively equivalent relevant experience.

• Proven experience in strategic sourcing and category management managing suppliers and commercial agreements within indirect material and services.

• Strong commercial and analytical capabilities within spend analysis, tendering, negotiation, and total cost of ownership (TCO) assessment.

• Knowledge of sustainability requirements and compliance standards within logistics and procurement.

• Fluency in English and proficiency in at least one Scandinavian language, both written and spoken.

• Experience within logistics, transportation, supply chain, or FMCG environments is considered highly advantageous.

Personal Attributes

We are looking for a proactive, accountable, analytical, and solution-oriented professional who enjoys working in an international environment. You have excellent communication and organizational skills and thrive when collaborating across functions, countries, and cultures.

A service-minded, flexible approach combined with a continuous improvement mindset will be essential for success in this role.

Application

We welcome your application for the position of Procurement Category Manager Logistics & Transport. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. For further information, please contact Talent Acquisition Specialist James Li at James.Li@valueone.se.

About ValueOne

ValueOne specializes in Supply Chain Management, Procurement, and Logistics. We support our clients through three business areas:

• Interim Procurement and Supply Chain Consultants

• Recruitment of Procurement and Logistics Professionals

• Management Consulting

Through our consulting services, we help organizations develop and improve their procurement, logistics, and supply chain capabilities covering strategy, operating models, processes, organization, governance, and competence development.

With more than 8,000 employees, Deloitte is one of the largest professional services firms across the Nordics. We help clients navigate complex business and technology transformations by combining deep industry expertise with leading capabilities in Audit, Tax, Advisory, and Consulting.

About the team

Join our Transfer Pricing team of more than 45 colleagues in Copenhagen and Aarhus. We help international and Danish businesses turn complex tax, finance and operating-model questions into practical solutions. As a Manager, you will bring your experience to a collaborative team, take a leading role in client engagements and contribute to developing our people and practice.

You will lead a broad range of projects for clients across sectors. Working with colleagues across Deloitte, you will turn complex analyses into practical advice and take responsibility for engagements from planning through to delivery. You will also help develop less experienced colleagues and continue building your own technical and leadership skills through training in Denmark and at Deloitte University in Paris.

Ready to take the next step in your career? In this role, you will:

• Manage transfer pricing engagements across advisory, compliance and disputes, overseeing teams, timelines and quality.

• Build client relationships and deliver practical advice with colleagues across Deloitte’s international network.

• Develop less experienced colleagues through feedback, work review and knowledge sharing.

• Help grow our practice by spotting new opportunities and shaping solutions for existing and new clients.

We work in a dynamic, international environment with an informal tone, where quality, collaboration and different perspectives are central to how we create value for clients and for each other.

AI-enabled and digital tools are a natural part of how we work. You will help identify where they can add value to research, analysis and delivery, while applying sound judgement and maintaining responsibility for the quality of the work. No specialist AI expertise is required, but curiosity and a willingness to improve how we work matter most.

We value the community that extends beyond client work. Our employee association brings people together throughout the year - from social events to shared experiences that cut across teams and business units. We celebrate the wins, big and small, and make a point of recognising individual and shared milestones.

The role is full-time, and we are looking for professionals for our offices in both Copenhagen and Aarhus, Denmark.

We are looking for experienced transfer pricing professionals who are ready to take responsibility for client engagements and contribute to the development of our team. You may already be working as a Manager ready for the next step.

You combine technical expertise with a practical understanding of client needs. You take ownership, collaborate openly and are comfortable coordinating the work of others while remaining hands-on with analysis and delivery.

What you bring to the team:

• A relevant academic background, such as law, economics, finance, accounting or business.

• Solid experience in transfer pricing, gained in an advisory firm, an in-house role or a comparable environment (minimum 5 years).

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn complex technical and financial information into clear recommendations.

• Curiosity about technology and judgement when using AI-enabled tools.

• Clear written and verbal communication, and confidence discussing technical matters with clients and colleagues.

• An interest in developing others through guidance, feedback and knowledge sharing.

• A strong client-service mindset and an interest in building relationships and contributing to new opportunities.

Send your CV, grade transcript and an application outlining your motivation for joining our Transfer Pricing team and highlighting relevant experience by 4 December 2026. We regularly call for interviews, so send your application already today.

The role will conduct risk-based third-party due diligence screenings and provide business-line advice to mitigate identified risks, conduct compliance training, support investigation case management, and support data privacy monitoring and follow-up.

About the team

You will join the Legal & Compliance team and work closely with Group Compliance program heads, Regional Legal & Compliance teams, corporate functions, and business stakeholders.

The position is located at our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, and reporting to the Head of Group Compliance Due Diligence Program.

About the role

As Group Compliance Manager, you will support the effective operation of key Group Compliance programs. You will conduct compliance due diligence screenings and provide business-line compliance advice, contribute to internal investigations, conduct compliance training and support the overall execution of training and communication priorities, and support data privacy documentation and reporting.

In this newly established role, you will help translate Group Compliance requirements into practical, well-documented processes and provide reliable support to stakeholders across functions and regions.

Key Responsibilities

• Administer due diligence systems and manage the intake, prioritization, status tracking, and records for third-party due diligence requests

• Independently conduct risk-based due diligence screenings, prepare screening reports, identify risk indicators, and recommend proportionate mitigating actions to the business

• Maintain screening documentation and prepare periodic management reports on anti-corruption, competition law, sanctions and export controls, and data privacy risks

• Support investigation case management, including intake, assignment, coordination, documentation, status tracking, remediation, closure, and reporting

• Contribute to the delivery of Group Compliance training, communications, and read-and-sign campaigns, including completion reporting

• Assist with the establishment and administration of data privacy management systems, templates, registers, assessments, agreements, gap records, and key compliance metrics

What you bring

At Bavarian Nordic, we are driven by purpose, accountability, and integrity. We are looking for a structured and hands-on compliance professional who can manage detailed workflows, conduct sound risk assessments, maintain accurate records, and collaborate effectively with stakeholders across the organization.

You likely bring:

• Master’s degree in law, finance/accounting, business, or a related field

• Minimum 3 years’ in-house corporate compliance experience

• Hands-on experience in due diligence, case management, and compliance training

• Regulated-industry experience is an advantage

You have a sharp eye for details and an analytical mindset. You understand the business and can communicate clearly and persuasively.

Why join Bavarian Nordic?

As we continue to develop our compliance function, you will help strengthen the day-to-day operation, documentation, monitoring, and reporting of our global programs.

In this role, you will:

• Work across key Group Compliance programs in a global, regulated business

• Gain hands-on experience in due diligence, investigations, training, communications, and data privacy

• Be part of a function grounded in professionalism, integrity, accountability, and collaboration

Alongside these opportunities, we offer:

• A collaborative workplace with colleagues across countries and functions

• Professional development opportunities and exposure to the wider business

• Flexible working conditions, pension, health insurance, and bonus opportunities

• A high-quality canteen with a wide selection and take-away options

• Fitness discounts, a massage scheme, and an active staff club offering social and sporting events

Salary

Annual base salary range: DKK 720,000 to 900,000 gross.

At Bavarian Nordic, we are committed to fair and transparent pay. The final base salary within this range will be determined based on the candidate’s relevant experience, qualifications, and competencies, as well as internal pay equity.

Interested?

If you are ready to bring your compliance expertise to a fast-growing global vaccine company, apply now and join Bavarian Nordic in our mission to improve health outcomes and foster sustainable growth.

Please note that for this position, we do not support any relocation packages. Candidates must possess a legal basis to work and reside in Denmark.

We kindly request that headhunters or recruitment agencies refrain from contacting us regarding this position.

Bavarian Nordic is a global vaccine company with a mission to improve health and save lives through innovative vaccines. We are a preferred supplier of mpox and smallpox vaccines to governments to enhance public health preparedness and have a leading portfolio of travel vaccines. We are headquartered in Denmark and have manufacturing, research, and sales offices across Europe and North America.

Bavarian Nordic is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applications will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

For more information, visit www.bavarian-nordic.com

jobs.occupation: NPI Engineer
jobs.description:
**Join us to Make an Impact

**Innovation is in our DNA. We invented supercontinuum lasers and photonic crystal fibers and we constantly reimagine how our products can be used and improved. Our customers use our products in medical and life science research, quantum computing and space exploration.

We seek curious, creative and collaborative people to work in our cutting-edge company. Can you see yourself working in teams and providing solutions for innovators?

If you wish to apply, please contact us with your CV / Résumé. If you have a cover letter, please save this in one document with your CV / Résumé as you are only able to upload one document.

We look forward to hearing from you!

We are rapidly growing, so we are looking for an additional engineer to join our New Product Introduction (NPI) team.

Our NPI team is organized in Product Engineering within Engineering. NPI bridges the gap between product development and volume production, being the place where prototypes and first sales units are manufactured and tested.

NPI is working closely together with development engineers (optical, electrical, mechanical and software engineers) for maturing the product, but also with automation engineers on manufacturing processes.

When a product has proven it can be manufactured with satisfactory yield and volume justifies, it will be transferred to our Operations department, freeing up space and resources for the new next thing.

In NPI we have a team of highly skilled technicians and engineers. Our technicians are the crank as they are manufacturing by far the most prototypes and sales units.

As NPI Engineer you will:

• Mastering and improving existing production processes – training, and supporting technicians.

• Troubleshooting issues, performing failure analysis, identifying root causes, and implementing corrective actions.

• Analyzing test and manufacturing data to identify and implement improvements in quality and productivity.

• Collaborating with Operations and other departments to transfer mature products and processes into production.

**Qualifications

**To succeed in this role, you should have a technical background in one or more of the following areas: optics/photonics, electronics, or production engineering. You have a strong affinity for processes and enjoy enabling others to follow them accurately.

Additionally, you bring:

• Experience with complex technical systems (e.g., optical fibers, free space optics, or electronic test setups).

• A proactive and process-driven mindset.

• A few years of experience from a manufacturing environment.

• Proficiency in written and spoken English. Being able to speak Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement.

• You thrive in an environment where technical challenges and deadlines are part of everyday life. You enjoy teamwork – asking for help when needed and supporting colleagues when possible.

**Keep your personal data safe

**Hamamatsu ("The Company") take responsibly for the protection of your personal data. Accordingly, upon receiving your job application and additional material you choose to submit, the Company keeps a safe and secure environment and ensures confidentiality.

You also have a role to play in keeping your personal data safe. We request you only submit personal data about yourself in your job application, CV / Résumé or other relevant material you choose to provide to us that is relevant for the specific job opening you are applying for.

Please consider whether there is personal information you are about to submit, such as health information, information on family relations, information on trade union membership, etc. that is not necessary for our recruitment process or the job opening you are applying for. Please also be aware that certificates or other documents are not necessary for the vacancy. We urgently request you to redact/cross out such information before you submit your job application.

Thank you.
